lines.en: I walk sideways with my pincers raised.

lines.zh: 我六条腿在沙上哒哒响。
lines.en: My six legs tap on the sand.
I crawl from the beach toward the mangroves.
I walk a stretch along the tide line.
I go around a patch of shell fragments.
I leave fine tracks on the wet sand.
I cross the shallows sideways.
I climb onto a rock.
I climb up a mangrove root.
I stop at the edge of a sand hollow.
I shift slowly into the shade.
I pause at each step, pincers forward.
I glance back at the tide.
I move a little further up the beach.
I slip under a stone.
I climb from the water's edge onto dry sand.
I crouch with my pincers half open.
Seawater washes over my feet.
I snap my pincers at the air.
My eye stalks turn a full circle.
Sand clings to my shell.
I listen to the tide.
I blow bubbles with the water in my gills.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把一只钳子放下。
lines.en: I lower one pincer slowly.
The sun has dried my shell.
It is cool among the mangrove roots.
I shift onto my side slightly.
Seabirds call in the distance.
I tuck all my legs beneath me.
The wind on the shore tastes of salt.
You have stepped onto my sand.

lines.zh: 我这对钳子能拉开距离。
lines.en: These pincers can extend your reach.
Why are you picking me up?
I only drop a pincer once grown.
I can stay in the sea or on land.
I can even climb a log.
Do you have kelp in your hand?
I walk sideways because it looks good.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就不举钳了。
lines.en: One step back and I will lower my pincers.
I only want a bit of kelp.
Sand works its way into the crack.
I hold my claws up in front of me.
My pincers slackened.
I pull in my legs and dig into the sand.
A little of my blood is on the sand.
I draw myself in.
My claw's still here. Don't gloat.
My pincers are still raised.
I steady myself slowly.
I can still walk sideways.
Kelp? I smell the sea.
Set it down; I will sidle over.
I grip it with a pincer.
This will not fill a seam.
Once I have the kelp, I'm off.
Set the kelp down; my claws are long.
The kelp melts slowly in my mouth.
Do you have more kelp?
After this I will climb that log.
Just right — it is fresh.
Your boot came down on my claw.
I sidle back half a step.
I slip a little on the sand.

lines.zh: 我的钳子碰到你的靴子。
lines.en: My pincer touches your boot.
That was nothing.

lines.zh: 沙被我们踩得乱七八糟。
lines.en: The sand is a mess under our feet.
I raise a pincer to block.
You stepped into my hollow.
I have steadied again.
Move aside; I want to climb past.
Let us walk the tide line together.
You dig, I will gather shells.

lines.zh: 我的钳子能递东西给你。
lines.en: My pincers can pass you things.
The mangrove roots can hide us both.
Do not step in my hollow.
The tide is out; let us dig in the sand.
I walk sideways; follow me.
When I raise a pincer, it is a greeting.
We share this beach.
When the tide returns, we stop.
I take it with a pincer.
Too tight and it will break.
It slipped. I try again.
I hold it up for you to see.
I tuck it under my shell with a claw.
This thing is alive.
This weighs more than my shell does.
I nudge it over to you sideways.
It fell into the water.
I hold it up and will not let go.
Something is moving in the sand.

lines.zh: 这只钳子，能拉长你的手。
lines.en: This claw extends your reach.
I will sidle around first.
Its shell is softer than mine.
Once I clamp, I do not let go.
I wait for you to come near.
The water is behind me. I can retreat.

lines.zh: 我这对钳子，能拉长你的手。
lines.en: These claws of mine can stretch your reach.
My shell can take a blow.
Only my eye stalks show above the sand.
I approach slowly, sideways.
My pincers are open.
Your back is turned to me.
I wait for you to step into soft sand.
I flatten myself against the sand.
The tide covers my sound.

lines.zh: 我横着挪，用钳子量你的距离。
lines.en: I sidestep, measuring your distance with my claws.
My claw already reaches your ankle.
It has backed against the rock.
I am ready to clamp.

lines.zh: 钳子把你的手指夹住了。
lines.en: My claw clamps onto your fingers.

lines.zh: 这一下夹到了你的脚趾。
lines.en: That caught your toe.
I ram sideways.

lines.zh: 它被我从沙里拽了出来。
lines.en: I dragged it out of the sand.
It shook me loose.
I rolled once and righted myself.
Sand sprays everywhere.
I clamp again.
It retreats; I follow.
I withdraw to the water's edge.
Feed me kelp and I'll follow.
There is one more crab on the beach.
First I take one sideways circuit.
I crawl out from under the mangrove roots.
It is cool under the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 我横着走，钳子先伸出去。
lines.en: I walk sideways, claws reaching first.
I raise my pincers.
The wind on the shore is salty.
I have found a good hollow.
This beach is room enough for me.

lines.zh: 壳烤得发烫，我往水里钻。
lines.en: My shell is scorched; I scuttle for water.

lines.zh: 我从石头上摔下来，壳一震。
lines.en: I fall off the rock and my shell jars.
Water floods my shell and I kick wildly.
The blast flips me over.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在我的甲缝里。
lines.en: Something is stuck in my shell's seam.

lines.zh: 一股冷意让我的钳子僵住。
lines.en: A cold force stiffens my pincers.
I can find no kelp on the shore.

lines.zh: 雷打在水边，我浑身一缩。
lines.en: Lightning strikes by the water and I clench.
I sink, and even the sand is gone.
